62317-the-undesirable-governess.title: Governess
62317-the-undesirable-governess.creator: Unknown
62317-the-undesirable-governess.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “No,” answered Lady Jane, and a short pause followed, for the subject was a sore one. “I have not done anything about getting a governess,” she added presently, in the tone suitable to armed neutrality.

arxiv-1604-05689.title: Accurate Online Full Charge Capacity Modeling of Smartphone Batteries
arxiv-1604-05689.creator: Mohammad A. Hoque, Matti Siekkinen, Jonghoe Koo, and Sasu Tarkoma
arxiv-1604-05689.description: Abstract Full charge capacity (FCC) refers to the amount of energy a battery can hold. It is the fundamental property of smartphone batteries that diminishes as the battery ages and is charged/discharged. We investigate the behavior of smartphone batteries while charging and demonstrate that the battery voltage and charging rate information can together characterize the FCC of a battery.

arxiv-2112-07936.title: Nondegeneracy of the positive solutions for critical nonlinear Hartree equation in ℝ 6 \R^{6}
arxiv-2112-07936.creator: Xuemei Li, Xingdong Tang, Guixiang Xu
arxiv-2112-07936.description: Abstract . We prove that any positive solution for the critical nonlinear Hartree equation − ⁣ △ ⁡ u ⁡ ( x ) − ∫ ℝ 6 | u ⁡ ( y ) | 2 | x − y | 4 ​ dy ​ u ​ ( x ) = 0 , x ∈ ℝ 6 . -\Laplacian{u}\left(x\right)-\int_{\R^{6}}\frac{\left|{u}\left(y\right)\right|^{2}}{\left|x-y\right|^{4}}\mathrm{d}y\,{u}\left(x\right)=0,\quad\text{}\quad x\in\R^{6}.

arxiv-2201-06994.title: Flexible clustering via hidden hierarchical Dirichlet priors
arxiv-2201-06994.description: Abstract The Bayesian approach to inference stands out for naturally allowing borrowing information across heterogeneous populations, with different samples possibly sharing the same distribution. A popular Bayesian nonparametric model for clustering probability distributions is the nested Dirichlet process, which however has the drawback of grouping distributions in a single cluster when ties are observed across samples.

arxiv-2203-00125.title: Pervasive beyond room-temperature ferromagnetism in a doped van der Waals magnet
arxiv-2203-00125.creator: Xiang Chen, Yu-Tsun Shao, Rui Chen, Sandhya Susarla, Tom Hogan, Yu He, Hongrui Zhang, Siqi Wang, Jie Yao, Peter Ercius, David A. Muller, Ramamoorthy Ramesh, Robert J. Birgeneau
arxiv-2203-00125.description: Abstract The existence of long range magnetic order in low dimensional magnetic systems, such as the quasi-two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) magnets, has attracted intensive studies of new physical phenomena. The vdW Fe N GeTe 2 ( N N = 3, 4, 5; FGT) family is exceptional owing to its vast tunability of magnetic properties.

arxiv-2205-11792.title: On large externally definable sets in NIP Thanks: Bays was partially supported by DFG EXC 2044–390685587 and ANR-DFG AAPG2019 (Geomod). Ben-Neria was partially supported by the Israel Science Foundation, Grant 1832/19. Kaplan would like to thank the Israel Science Foundation (ISF) for their support
arxiv-2205-11792.creator: Martin Bays, Omer Ben-Neria, Itay Kaplan, Pierre Simon
arxiv-2205-11792.description: Abstract . We study cofinal systems of finite subsets of ω 1 \omega_{1} . We show that while such systems can be NIP, they cannot be defined in an NIP structure. We deduce a positive answer to a question of Chernikov and Simon from 2013: in an NIP theory, any uncountable externally definable set contains an infinite definable subset.

arxiv-2206-09552.title: Dynamic Message Propagation Network for RGB-D Salient Object Detection
arxiv-2206-09552.creator: Baian Chen, Zhilei Chen, Xiaowei Hu, Jun Xu, Haoran Xie, Mingqiang Wei, Jing Qin
arxiv-2206-09552.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel deep neural network framework for RGB-D salient object detection by controlling the message passing between the RGB images and depth maps on the feature level and exploring the long-range semantic contexts and geometric information on both RGB and depth features to infer salient objects.

arxiv-2208-12543.title: Parameterized Complexity of Binary CSP: Vertex Cover, Treedepth, and Related Parameters
arxiv-2208-12543.creator: Hans L. Bodlaender, Carla Groenland, Michał Pilipczuk
arxiv-2208-12543.description: Abstract We investigate the parameterized complexity of Binary CSP parameterized by the vertex cover number and the treedepth of the constraint graph, as well as by a selection of related modulator-based parameters. The main findings are as follows: • Binary CSP parameterized by the vertex cover number is W ⁡ [ 3 ] \mathrm{W}[3] -complete.

arxiv-2310-15382.title: Topological constraints on general relativistic galaxies: Exploring novel conical singularity networks
arxiv-2310-15382.creator: Marco Galoppo
arxiv-2310-15382.description: Abstract The van Stockum-Bonner class of spacetimes can be interpreted as fully general relativistic models for rigidly rotating disc galaxies. Frame-dragging effects in these geometries demand a recalibration of the dark matter content relative to models based on Newtonian gravity.

arxiv-2404-12435.title: Observed abundance of X-ray low surface brightness clusters in optical, X-ray, and SZ selected samples
arxiv-2404-12435.creator: S. Andreon 1, G. Trinchieri 1, A. Moretti 1
arxiv-2404-12435.description: Abstract The comparison of the properties of galaxy cluster samples selected using observations in different wavebands may shed light on potential biases of the way in which the samples are assembled. For this comparison, we introduce a new observable that does not require previous knowledge of the cluster mass: the X-ray mean surface brightness within the central 300 kpc.

arxiv-2504-08059.title: The canonical ensemble of a self-gravitating matter thin shell in AdS
arxiv-2504-08059.creator: Tiago V. Fernandes, Francisco J. Gandum, José P. S. Lemos
arxiv-2504-08059.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tiago V. Fernandes, Francisco J. Gandum, José P. S. Lemos. We build the canonical ensemble of a hot self-gravitating matter thin shell in anti-de Sitter (AdS) space by finding its partition function through the Euclidean path integral approach with fixed temperature at the conformal boundary. We obtain the reduced action of the system by restricting the path integral to spherically symmetric metrics with given boundary conditions and with the Hamiltonian constraint satisfied.

arxiv-2508-16629.title: Learn to Memorize: Optimizing LLM-based Agents with Adaptive Memory Framework
arxiv-2508-16629.creator: Zeyu Zhang, Quanyu Dai, Rui Li, Xiaohe Bo, Xu Chen, Zhenhua Dong
arxiv-2508-16629.description: Abstract LLM-based agents have been extensively applied across various domains, where memory stands out as one of their most essential capabilities. Previous memory mechanisms of LLM-based agents are manually predefined by human experts, leading to higher labor costs and suboptimal performance.

arxiv-2511-06037.title: Radio AGN feedback sustains quiescence only in a minority of massive galaxies
arxiv-2511-06037.creator: Huiling Liu 1,2, Yan Lu 3,4, Hui Hong 1,2,5, Huiyuan Wang 1,2, Houjun Mo 6, Jing Wang 7, Wanli Ouyang 3,4, Ziwen Zhang 1,2, Enci Wang 1,2, Hongxin Zhang 1,2, Yangyao Chen 1,2, Qinxun Li 1,2,8, Hao Li 1,2, Mengkui Zhou 1,2
arxiv-2511-06037.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Huiling Liu 1,2, Yan Lu 3,4, Hui Hong 1,2,5, Huiyuan Wang 1,2, Houjun Mo 6, Jing Wang 7, Wanli Ouyang 3,4, Ziwen Zhang 1,2, Enci Wang 1,2, Hongxin Zhang 1,2, Yangyao Chen 1,2, Qinxun Li 1,2,8, Hao Li 1,2, Mengkui Zhou 1,2. Radio active galactic nuclei (AGNs) eject a huge amount of energy into the surrounding medium and are thought to potentially prevent gas cooling and maintain the quiescence of massive galaxies [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .

arxiv-2512-24034.title: Push-forward of smooth measures and strong Thom stratifications
arxiv-2512-24034.creator: Avraham Aizenbud, Nir Avni, and Shahar Carmeli
arxiv-2512-24034.description: Abstract . We study the collection of measures obtained via push-forward along a map between smooth varieties over p-adic fields. We investigate when the stalks of this collection are finite-dimensional. We provide an algebro-geometric criterion ensuring this property. This criterion is formulated in terms of a canonical subvariety of the cotangent bundle of the source of the map. 1.

arxiv-2601-22224.title: Probing Entanglement and Symmetries in Random States Using a Superconducting Quantum Processor
arxiv-2601-22224.creator: Jia-Nan Yang, Lata Kh Joshi, Filiberto Ares, Yihang Han, Pengfei Zhang, Pasquale Calabrese
arxiv-2601-22224.description: Abstract Quantum many-body systems display an extraordinary degree of complexity, yet many of their features are universal: they depend not on microscopic details, but on a few fundamental physical aspects such as symmetries. A central challenge is to distill these universal characteristics from model-specific ones.

burden-quest-for-the-dragon-of-komodo-19.title: "The Quest for the Dragon of Komodo"
burden-quest-for-the-dragon-of-komodo-19.creator: W. Douglas Burden
burden-quest-for-the-dragon-of-komodo-19.description: Burden's 1927 Natural History account of the expedition that captured the Komodo dragon — the 'living dragon' brought to America, an inspiration for King Kong.

europmc-pmc3944461.title: The ZEB1 pathway links glioblastoma initiation, invasion and chemoresistance.
europmc-pmc3944461.creator: Siebzehnrubl FA, Silver DJ, Tugertimur B, Deleyrolle LP, Siebzehnrubl D, Sarkisian MR, Devers KG, Yachnis AT, Kupper MD, Neal D, Nabilsi NH, Kladde MP, Suslov O, Brabletz S, Brabletz T, Reynolds BA, Steindler DA.
europmc-pmc3944461.description: Glioblastoma remains one of the most lethal types of cancer, and is the most common brain tumour in adults. In particular, tumour recurrence after surgical resection and radiation invariably occurs regardless of aggressive chemotherapy. Here, we provide evidence that the...

govdocs-archive_org-e-bruno-cariou-berse.title: Masquerade
govdocs-archive_org-e-bruno-cariou-berse.creator: Bruno Cariou
govdocs-archive_org-e-bruno-cariou-berse.description: Essay by Bruno Cariou opening with Voltaire and Agamben on medicine and the state, developing into a polemic on the 'viral masquerade' of the present.

pmc-10448375.title: Optimizing Uptake of Multimodal Pain Management After Surgery Using the Electronic Health Record
pmc-10448375.creator: Tasce Bongiovanni, Elizabeth Lancaster, Matthias Behrends, Li Zhang, Elizabeth Wick, Andrew Auerbach, Mark J. Pletcher
pmc-10448375.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This quality improvement study evaluates the effect of an electronic health record intervention on multimodal pain management following surgery in 2 randomized clinical trials. Multimodal pain regimens that include acetaminophen and nonsteroidal antiinflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) may help reduce the use of opioids for pain management in the postoperative period and are increasingly used in enhanced recovery pathways,1,2 although uptake has been challenging.

pmc-10541432.title: Anti-EGFR bioengineered bacterial outer membrane vesicles as targeted immunotherapy candidate in triple-negative breast tumor murine model
pmc-10541432.creator: Razieh Rezaei Adriani, Seyed Latif Mousavi Gargari, Hamid Bakherad, Jafar Amani
pmc-10541432.description: Cancer immunotherapy employing checkpoint inhibitors holds great promise across diverse cancers; nonetheless, a substantial proportion of patients (ranging from 55 to 87%) remain unresponsive to this treatment. To amplify therapeutic efficiency, we propose a synergistic therapeutic strategy that entails the deployment of targeted nano-sized particles carrying Toll-like receptor (TLR) agonists to the tumor site.

pmc-10629974.title: Discriminating between sick and healthy faces based on early sickness cues: an exploratory analysis of sex differences
pmc-10629974.creator: Arnaud Tognetti, Evelina Thunell, Marta Zakrzewska, Jonas Olofsson, Mats Lekander, John Axelsson, Mats J Olsson
pmc-10629974.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and objectivesIt has been argued that sex and disease-related traits should influence how observers respond to sensory sickness cues. In fact, there is evidence that humans can detect sensory cues related to infection in others, but lack of power from earlier studies prevents any firm conclusion regarding whether perception of sickness cues is associated with sex and disease-related personality traits.

pmc-11547022.title: Evaluation of Targeted Alpha Therapy Using [211At]FAPI1 in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Xenograft Models
pmc-11547022.creator: Kaori Abe, Tadashi Watabe, Kazuko Kaneda-Nakashima, Yoshifumi Shirakami, Yuichiro Kadonaga, Sadahiro Naka, Kazuhiro Ooe, Atsushi Toyoshima, Frederik Giesel, Takeshi Usui, Nanae Masunaga, Chieko Mishima, Masami Tsukabe, Tetsuhiro Yoshinami, Yoshiaki Sota, Tomohiro Miyake, Tomonori Tanei, Masafumi Shi
pmc-11547022.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) presents limited therapeutic options and is associated with poor prognosis. Early detection and the development of novel therapeutic agents are therefore imperative. Fibroblast activation protein (FAP) is a membrane protein expressed on cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) that plays an essential role in TNBC proliferation, migration, and invasion.

pmc-11710684.title: Inhibition of Smad4 improves the cognitive function of APP/PS1 mice by targeting the level of c1qa
pmc-11710684.creator: Jianwei Ge, Benyan Luo
pmc-11710684.description: BackgroundSynaptic plasticity impairment plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Smad4, a central intracellular signal transmission mediator of transmission of transforming growth factor‐β (TGF‐β) signaling, plays a pivotal role in many biological processes, including cell differentiation, migration, apoptosis and tumorigenesis. Emerging evidence has demonstrated that Smad4 is also involved in the pathogenesis of AD.

pmc-12583076.title: Exploring the impact of SNPs rs2476601, rs2488457, and rs33996649 on PTPN22 expression, structure, and anti-CCP level in rheumatoid arthritis of the Indian population: a case-control and computational study
pmc-12583076.creator: S. Aswini, S. Asha Devi
pmc-12583076.description: BackgroundProtein Tyrosine Phosphatase Non-Receptor Type 22 (PTPN22) gene encodes for Lymphoid-Specific Tyrosine Phosphatase (LYP), predominantly expressed in T lymphocytes to regulate the immune responses by modulating T-cell proliferation and activation. Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs) in PTPN22 alter the structure and function of LYP, leading to dysregulation of T-cell response and increasing the risk for autoimmune disease.

pmc-12996449.title: Landscape of circular RNAs in acute myeloid leukemia and their clinical significance
pmc-12996449.creator: Thi-Hau Nguyen, Manh-Hung Nguyen, Ha-Nam Nguyen, Tom Erkers, Päivi Östling, Anna Bohlin, Albin Österroos, Rozbeh Jafari, Lukas M Orre, Janne Lehtiö, Sören Lehmann, Olli Kallioniemi, Yudi Pawitan, Trung Nghia Vu
pmc-12996449.description: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as important regulators in cancer biology, but their roles in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) remain poorly characterized due to limited sample sizes and technical challenges in RNA sequencing. Here, we analyze RNA-sequencing data from 315 Swedish AML patients to create the most comprehensive circRNA profile in AML to date.

pmc-13227108.title: MDNA : a software module for DNA structure generation and analysis
pmc-13227108.creator: Thor van Heesch, Enrico Skoruppa, Peter G Bolhuis, Helmut Schiessel, Jocelyne Vreede
pmc-13227108.description: Exploring the dynamical and structural properties of molecular complexes involving DNA is a fundamentally important aspect of understanding many biological processes. Although tools exist for modeling linear DNA and simple complexes, significant challenges remain in generating intricate biomolecular assemblies and incorporating biologically relevant modifications. These limitations restrict the ability to create accurate starting configurations for advanced molecular simulation studies.

pmc-13238878.title: Sensory Properties and Aroma Compound Profiles of Pea Protein Isolates in Relation to High Hydrostatic Pressure and High‐Pressure Homogenization Treatments
pmc-13238878.creator: Lea Friedrich, Christina Hopf, Laura Scheuer, Pauline Fauquet, Gina Zeh
pmc-13238878.description: Plant‐derived proteins are becoming increasingly important due to consumer demand for plant‐based alternatives to animal products. Processing of these proteins can negatively affect their flavor. While there have been many investigations into the role of thermal processing, the impact of high‐pressure treatment (i.e., high hydrostatic pressure and high‐pressure homogenization) on the flavor profile of plant‐derived proteins is still unclear.

pmc-13345297.title: Predictors of psychiatric emergency department visits within twelve months post-inpatient psychiatric discharge in Alberta, Canada
pmc-13345297.creator: Hossam Eldin Elgendy, Reham Shalaby, Ernest Owusu, Wanying Mao, Belinda Agyapong, Wes Vuong, Ejemai Eboreime, Nnamdi Nkire, Yifeng Wei, Vincent I. O. Agyapong
pmc-13345297.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPsychiatric emergency department (ED) visits following discharge from inpatient psychiatric care remain a significant challenge for mental health systems and may reflect gaps in continuity of care and community support. While sociodemographic and clinical predictors of recurrent ED utilization have been widely studied, the role of inpatient satisfaction and transitional care interventions in predicting post-discharge psychiatric ED visits remains less clear.ObjectivesThis study aimed to examine predictors of psychiatric ED visits within 12 months following discharge from acute psychiatric inpatient units, with particular

pmc-13379492.title: Dual-depth 25-pin insulated microneedle radiofrequency for moderate-to-severe periorbital wrinkles
pmc-13379492.creator: Kyung Tae Bae, So Yoon Park, Yerin Park, Kyu-Ho Yi
pmc-13379492.description: To evaluate efficacy and safety of dual-depth 25-pin insulated microneedle radiofrequency (RF) treatment for periorbital wrinkles and skin elasticity. This observational study included 32 adults aged 30–60 years with baseline Fitzpatrick Wrinkle Assessment Scale (FWAS) scores of 4 or higher. Patients underwent three microneedle RF treatment sessions at 4-week intervals.

pmc-13508797.title: Effects of improved water, sanitation, handwashing, and nutrition on early childhood IgG immune repertoire development against Shigella and enteroinvasive Escherichia coli (EIEC)
pmc-13508797.creator: Nikolina Walas, Everlyn Kamau, Minlu Zhang, Kathy Kamath, Jack Reifert, John Shon, Shahjahan Ali, Md. Ziaur Rahman, Abul K. Shoab, Syeda L. Famida, Salma Akther, Md. Saheen Hossen, Palash Mutsuddi, Mahbubur Rahman, Jessica A. Grembi, Andrew N. Mertens, Taufiqur R. Bhuiyan, Firdausi Qadri, Edward T.
pmc-13508797.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We studied the effects of a combined water, sanitation, handwashing, and nutritional supplementation (WSH + N) intervention on Shigella/EIEC IgG immune development among Bangladeshi children enrolled in a cluster-randomized trial. We used a bacterial display assay to measure IgG-specific binding to Shigella/EIEC Ipa proteins (IpaA, IpaB, IpaC, IpaD, and IpaH) from a substudy of 120 children (60 intervention, 60 control) at median ages 3, 14, and 28 months.

pmc-13651400.creator: Hai Chang Yin, Xin Yu Zhang, Song Liu, Xinjie Jiang, Tian Fei Yu, He Zhang, Di Liu, Chang You Xia

BackgroundPrevious studies have shown that microbiota in the respiratory tract play a significant role in shaping host immunity and reducing the risk of respiratory tract infections.
